offering_description.value: Owns select-service and upscale hotels in the United States and hires third-party managers to run them. Sells overnight rooms and hotel amenities to business and leisure travelers, mainly through franchised hotel brands.

primary_products.value: food and beverage; meeting and event space

primary_services.value: hotel lodging; event and conference services

customer_segment.value: B2C: leisure travelers and vacationers; B2B: business travelers, corporate accounts and group or meeting planners

revenue_model.value: service fees: nightly room rentals and hotel amenity fees; product sales: food, beverage and other on-site sales

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns hotel properties and hires managers to run them, sells rooms to guests; service provider: provides lodging, dining and event services to travelers and groups

geography_served.value: US national: hotels in many US states, with clusters in the Midwest, Southeast and Texas

specialization.value: niche specialist: select-service and upscale hotels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: corporate accounts and group or meeting bookings; online: company websites and third-party online booking platforms; agents / brokers: travel agents and tour operators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: hotel food, alcohol, fire safety and local lodging licensing rules, federal REIT tax rules
